name: harness-builder
description:
Build or improve a Claude Code harness (skills, agents, hooks, CLAUDE.md) the way Anthropic recommends, and prove it beats Claude with no harness.
- Orchestrator agent: research, design, build, eval, optimize. You approve every eval run and every change.
- 6 skills: harness, research, design, audit, eval, optimize
- hb script: audit an existing harness, estimate eval cost, track experiments, wrap a .claude folder for evals
Needs Node.js and Claude Code 2.1.269+.
